verdict.rationale: MoonPay's documented APIs and SDKs (sessions, quotes, buy/sell widgets) are built around individual end-user on-ramp/off-ramp transactions, not bulk or batch payout operations for an ops team. No evidence pack item mentions a batch/bulk payout endpoint, per-item status tracking, or mass disbursement capability. Missing for 10: any batch/bulk payout API, mass disbursement documentation, per-item status/reporting for bulk operations.
